paragraphs: Grandma has a new phone. It is blue and small. "Tom, can you teach me?" she asks. "Yes! I'm your grandson," says Tom. "First, we send a text." "What's a text?" asks Grandma. "It's a short message on the phone." "Write slowly, and look at the letters." "I want to ask your parents to dinner," says Grandma. Tom smiles, and Grandma is very happy.

Grandma writes a message with one hand. "Come to dinner at six o'clock." She looks for the green word "Send." She sends it. "It's easy!" she says. Then the phone makes a noise. "Look, Tom! There's an answer," says Grandma. Tom reads it to her. "Thank you, Grandma, but I'm Teacher Kim, not Tom's mom." "Oh no, I made a mistake!" says Grandma.

Tom laughs and laughs. Then Grandma laughs too. "It's OK," says Tom. "Teacher Kim is nice." "Then I can ask her to dinner," says Grandma. She sends a new text to Teacher Kim. Then Tom opens a website with pictures of food. The answer comes very quickly: "Yes, please!" "You're a clever grandson," says Grandma. "Now I can teach you something." "What's that?" asks Tom. "Come to the kitchen and learn my rice!"
text.summary: Tom teaches Grandma to send a text on her new phone. She makes a mistake and writes to Teacher Kim, who says yes to dinner.
